name:
Kitchen Refillable Lighter Kitchen Gas Lighter With Free Refill 
Random Colour
description:
Utility product designed for versatile use

Long stick design makes it easy to light candles, stoves, gas burners, crackers, and more

Uses common butane gas (same as cigarette lighters) – easily refillable from any local shop

Durable, convenient, and safe to use

Color: As shown in picture

Description:
This multi-purpose gas lighter is a practical and reliable tool for everyday use. Its long stick design ensures safe ignition for candles, stoves, or crackers, keeping your hands away from direct flame. Refillable with commonly available butane gas, it’s cost-effective and reusable. A must-have utility for every home.
